description: This file defines repository functions for managing 'Run' and 'Attempt' entities in a database, including creation, retrieval, listing, and status updates. It integrates with external storage services to augment assets with signed URLs and handles notification settings associated with runs.

classes.name: Run
classes.description: ORM model representing a run, including metadata and related attempts and assets.

classes.name: Attempt
classes.description: ORM model representing an attempt under a run, including status and associated assets.

classes.name: Asset
classes.description: ORM model for assets related to attempts or runs, including file metadata.

classes.name: NotificationSetting
classes.description: ORM model for storing notification configuration related to a run.

methods.name: AssetRef _augment_with_signed_url(ref: AssetRef)
methods.description: Enriches an AssetRef with a signed URL if storage is configured and the path matches certain conventions.

methods.name: AssetRef _to_asset_ref(a: Asset)
methods.description: Converts an Asset ORM object to an AssetRef and augments with signed URL.

methods.name: AttemptStatus _to_attempt_status(a: Attempt)
methods.description: Converts an Attempt ORM object to an AttemptStatus DTO, including assets.

methods.name: str _aggregate_run_status_from_attempts(attempts: List[Attempt])
methods.description: Determines aggregate run status based on statuses of associated attempts.

methods.name: RunStatus _to_run_status(r: Run)
methods.description: Converts a Run ORM object to a RunStatus DTO, including attempts and assets.
